name: draft-reconciler
description: Retires stale draft entries from knowledge.db whose source folder under astgl-articles/substack/ is gone (deleted or renamed Published_*). Runs 2h after the nightly drafts ingester so newly shipped pieces are retired the same night. Without this, MCP search returns the same content twice (rough draft + polished published version).

preExec.description: Hard-deletes stale draft entries (rows + chunks + vectors + qa). Auto-backs up data/knowledge.db to data/knowledge.db.bak.pre-reconcile-<ISO> before any DELETE; pass --no-backup to skip; pass --dry-run to preview only.

instructions: Review the JSON output: examined (total drafts in DB), retired[] (each with url, title, reason, chunks_deleted, qa_deleted), backup_path.
If retired count is unexpectedly high, check whether the substack/ folder layout changed (e.g., a sweep moved many drafts to /published/) — flag it.
If backup_path is set, the pre-run snapshot is on disk; clean up older snapshots manually after a week.
If 'reason' is 'url-malformed' for any retirement, that draft URL did not match the YYYY-MM-DD-slug pattern — investigate the source row before treating it as a clean retirement.
